Vendored from https://github.com/nibsbin/us-state-flags-svg (master), which re-hosts
Wikipedia's SVG tracings of each state flag. That repo carries no LICENSE file; its README
states the images were pulled from public domain sources on 10/11/2019 — consistent with US
state flags being government works with no federal copyright.

Re-vendor with `node scripts/vendor-state-flags.mjs`, then rebuild with `node scripts/bake-state-flags.mjs`.
